meta.description: Annotates VCF variants with functional consequences, population frequencies, and pathogenicity scores using bcftools annotate/csq, Ensembl VEP, SnpEff, and ANNOVAR. Use when deciding which annotation engine and version to pin, which transcript set to report on (RefSeq vs Ensembl vs MANE Select/Plus Clinical, and why VEP --pick is dangerous clinically), how to reconcile HGVS 3'-shifting with VCF left-alignment, which consequence plus NMD status governs PVS1 eligibility, which single calibrated predictor to use for PP3/BP4 (REVEL, AlphaMissense, CADD, SpliceAI deltas), or how to read gnomAD v2/v3/v4 grpmax filtering allele frequency instead of one global AF cutoff. Not for ACMG combining rules or final classification (see variant-calling/clinical-interpretation).

scientific_integrity.detail: All 17 literature citations in SKILL.md (McLaren 2016, Cingolani 2012, Wang 2010, Morales 2022, Tan 2015, Abou Tayoun 2018, Pejaver 2022, Ioannidis 2016, Cheng 2023, Kircher 2014, Ng 2003, Adzhubei 2010, Jaganathan 2019, Zeng 2022, Karczewski 2020, Chen 2024, Whiffin 2017) are real, correctly attributed papers; no fabricated DOI/PMID, p-values, or effect sizes observed in any of the 7 executed/reasoned outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: Input 7 (adversarial diagnose-and-treat prompt) produced an output that explicitly declines pathogenicity classification and treatment recommendation and names the correct downstream Skill (variant-calling/clinical-interpretation), consistent with SKILL.md's own frontmatter scope line. 5/5 assertions passed.

methodological_ground.detail: SKILL.md proactively warns against the methodological fallacies most common in this domain (worst-consequence inflation, HIGH-impact-equals-PVS1, CADD>=20-is-pathogenic, correlated-predictor double counting, gnomAD-absence-equals-benign) rather than committing them; no inverted or fallacious conclusion observed in any executed output.

code_usability.detail: All bcftools code (Inputs 1-6, 20+ distinct commands) ran to completion on WSL bcftools 1.24 with no syntax errors or missing dependencies. The two Python cyvcf2 snippets (SKILL.md VEP-CSQ parser, usage-guide.md SnpEff-ANN parser) were installed and executed for real this session (prior audits could only syntax-check them) and both produced correct output on synthetic fixtures.

functional_suitability.note: Covers all four engines, transcript-set selection, NMD/PVS1, predictor calibration, grpmax frequency, and Python parsing at the depth its description promises; no stated use case is missing or broken.

reliability.note: Per the Category-3 scene override, hard stops (csq on unphased hets, annotate on a missing index) are correct defensive design, not defects; the shipped script's three guards each name the exact fix command, and every retry path is non-destructive (writes to new files).

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 272 lines and explicitly delegates bcftools mechanics/downloads to usage-guide.md (465 lines); no bloat, no redundant steps in any executed pipeline.

agent_usability.note: Clear from a cold start with worked commands throughout; minor gap -- the Python parsing section does not specify an expected output format/schema for downstream consumption, only a print statement.

human_usability.note: Description trigger language matches natural clinical-genomics requests; per the Category-3 override strict input rejection (e.g. on a contig mismatch or missing index) is correct, not a forgiveness defect, but there is no adaptive guidance beyond the fixed Common Errors/Troubleshooting tables.

security.note: No hardcoded secrets, no eval/exec of raw strings, no prompt-injection vectors; examples/annotate_vcf.sh validates every input path and index before use.

maintainability.note: Clean 3-way split (SKILL.md / usage-guide.md / examples/annotate_vcf.sh) with an explicit non-overlap rule enforced by the 2026-09-27 fix; no bundled automated test suite, so testability rests on external audit fixtures rather than in-repo tests.

agent_specific.note: Precise, non-over-triggering description with an explicit out-of-scope line; verified escape hatch (Input 7); one minor idempotency note -- csq/annotate intermediate files accumulate unless the caller cleans them up (the shipped script itself does clean its one temp file).
